sloka: कथम् इन्दीवर श्यामो रक्त अक्षः प्रिय दर्शनः ।सुख भागी च दुह्ख अर्हः शयितो भुवि राघवः ॥२-८८-१९॥
transliteration: katham indīvara śyāmo rakta akṣaḥ priya darśanaḥ ।sukha bhāgī ca duhkha arhaḥ śayito bhuvi rāghavaḥ ॥2-88-19॥

translations.english: How could such Rama sleep on the ground? He was born in the house of emperors, worthy of reverence by the entire world and beloved of all the worlds, with the complexion of a blue lotus, with red eyes, and pleasing looks, one who deserves to be happy and not to suffer by renouncing the kingdom and excellent comforts.
